newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound overnight rates fall after repo.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound overnight rates fall after repo.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound fell slightly on Sunday in a short market after a government 700 million pound ($206 million) repo, bankers said.
One banker said the market was "less tight" than on Thursday after the repo, effective for four days from Sunday.
Two bankers said the overnight rates were not much changed at 11-1/8 to 11-1/4, but other bankers quoted rates of 10-3/16 to 10-7/16.
One banker said the one week rate was 10-1/4 to 10-3/8.
"The market is still a bit tight. It seems the market has not reacted yet to the repo," said a banker.
Public sector banks offered rates of 10-1/2 percent.
